查询标签列表
 发起请求例子：
 ```
 curl -X POST "http://{host}:{port}/api/v3/horizon/v1/tag/definition/list" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "sensorsdata-project: {项目英文名}" \
  -H "api-key: {apiToken}" \
  -d '{"page_size": 2,"page": 1,"entity_name": "user", "show_deleted": true,"show_invisible": true}'
  ```

查询单个标签信息
 ```
 curl -X POST "http://{host}:{port}/api/v3/horizon/v1/tag/definition/get" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "sensorsdata-project: {projectName}" \
  -H "api-key: {token}" \
  -d '{ "entity_name": "user","show_deleted": true,"name": "user_tag_c1"}'
  ```

创建标签定义
 ```
 curl -X POST "http://{host}:{port}/api/v3/horizon/v1/tag/definition/create" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "sensorsdata-project: {projectName}" \
  -H "api-key: {token}" \
  -d '{"definition":{"entity_name":"user","create_type":"TAG_UPLOAD","source":{"app":"SDH","category":"TAG","sub_category":""},"storage_settings":{"version_count":1},"managed":true,"expression":{"tag_type":"LOADING_BASED","virtual":false,"filter_segment_at_last":fa

修改标签定义
```
curl -X POST "http://{host}:{port}/api/v3/horizon/v1/tag/definition/update" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "sensorsdata-project: {projectName}" \
  -H "api-key: {token}" \
  -d '{"definition":{"entity_name":"user","storage_settings":{"version_count":2},"expression":{"tag_type":"LOADING_BASED","virtual":false,"filter_segment_at_last":false,"entity_set_rules":[],"loading_based_rule":{"matched_field":"user.$identity_login_id","sync_flag":

删除标签定义
```
curl -X POST "http://{host}:{port}/api/v3/horizon/v1/tag/definition/delete" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "sensorsdata-project: {projectName}" \
  -H "api-key: {token}" \
  -d '{"entity_name":"user","name":"user_tag_zdybq","skip_trash":false}'
 返回值：
 {"code":"SUCCESS","request_id":"281138383035f9fd2bb394df6fe17970","data":{}}
```

恢复标签定义
```
curl -X POST "http://{host}:{port}/api/v3/horizon/v1/tag/definition/recover" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "sensorsdata-project: {projectName}" \
  -H "api-key: {token}" \
  -d '{"entity_name":"user","name":"user_tag_zdybq"}'
 返回值：
{"code":"SUCCESS","request_id":"281141337b94cc1225cf95803d55ef53","data":{"visible":false,"entity_name":"","create_type":"","tag_post_actions":[],"created_by":"","labels":[],"custom_params":{},"folder":"","

归档标签定义
```
curl -X POST "http://{host}:{port}/api/v3/horizon/v1/tag/definition/archive" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "sensorsdata-project: {projectName}" \
  -H "api-key: {token}" \
  -d '{"entity_name":"user","name":"user_tag_zdybq"}'
 返回值：
 {"code":"SUCCESS","request_id":"28114456e926d6e022c498ecdf24c3f7","data":{}}
```

从归档恢复标签定义
```
curl -X POST "http://{host}:{port}/api/v3/horizon/v1/tag/definition/recover-from-archive" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "sensorsdata-project: {projectName}" \
  -H "api-key: {token}" \
  -d '{"entity_name":"user","name":"user_tag_zdybq"}'
 返回值：
{"code":"SUCCESS","request_id":"281241337b94dc1235cf95803d56df53","data":{"visible":false,"entity_name":"","create_type":"","tag_post_actions":[],"created_by":"","labels":[],"custom_params":

执行标签计算
```
curl -X POST 'http://{host}:{port}/api/v3/horizon/v1/tag/definition/evaluate' \
-H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "sensorsdata-project: {projectName}" \
  -H "api-key: {token}" \
  -d '{"entity_name": "user","evaluate_params": [{"tag_definition_name": "user_tag_sbqsl","base_time": "2025-04-27T16:00:00Z"}]}'
```

更改调度状态 TAG_ACTIVE <--> TAG_SUSPENDED
```
curl -X POST "http://{host}:{port}/api/v3/horizon/v1/tag/definition/status/update" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "sensorsdata-project: {projectName}" \
  -H "api-key: {token}" \
  -d '{"entity_name":"user","tag_name":"user_tag_bq_meta_bool","status":"TAG_SUSPENDED"}'
```

取消计算任务,需要通过 task/get 接口先获取到计算任务的 task_id
 ```
curl -X POST "http://{host}:{port}/api/v3/horizon/v1/tag/task/cancel" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "sensorsdata-project: {projectName}" \
  -H "api-key: {token}" \
  -d '{"task_ids":[4121],"sync":"true","sync_timeout_seconds":30}'
 ```
